name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 6 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-08-09, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 3.46 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
